dataset: US Airfare Time Machine (38.46M flight-days after collapsing duplicate quotes)
metric: accuracy = 100 - MAPE on price (USD); within 10%; MAE; RMSE

splits.R: 5 routes held out (+reverse directions dropped from training)

permutation_importance_T_test.note: accuracy drop (percentage points) when the column(s) are shuffled on the test window; whole family shuffled together with one permutation. The anchor is recomputed from the shuffled last_price/route_med7.

direction_classifier_T.note: only rows whose price differs from the last observed price; this answers 'given a move, up or down?'. P(any move) is a separate question: 65% of next observations are unchanged.

random_forest_importance_T.note: accuracy drop (percentage points) when the column(s) are shuffled on the test window; whole family shuffled together with one permutation. The anchor is recomputed from the shuffled last_price/route_med7.
